answer:
The Windows documentation gives **551.61** as the minimum NVIDIA driver version: "NVIDIA 551.61 or newer Drivers if you have an NVIDIA card" [ollama/docs/windows.md].

The general hardware support page gives different numbers. It says "Ollama supports Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 5.0+ and driver version 550 and newer." [ollama/docs/gpu.md] It also says "Nvidia GPUs with compute capability 5.0 through 6.2 require driver version 570 or newer." [ollama/docs/gpu.md]

I can't tell from these documents which requirement is current, so the Windows-specific figure is the most direct answer. If you have an older card with compute capability 5.0 through 6.2, the gpu.md page indicates you need driver 570 or newer.
